title: Position: Fairness Failure in Generative Models is an Evaluation Problem
abstract: arXiv:2608.16974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite groundbreaking advancements in generative models during the last decade, concerns about their lack of fairness, reinforcing societal inequalities and harming marginalized groups, remain under-addressed and difficult to act upon. This position paper argues that fairness failures in generative models, albeit driven by multiple factors, are ultimately stemming from an evaluation problem: fairness findings are rarely comparable across papers or actionable for deployment decisions. This paper diagnoses recurring empirical and conceptual failure modes in current practice and motivates a shift from ad-hoc bias checks to standardized, generative-specific evaluation. We propose Fairness Cards as a minimal reporting artifact that makes evaluation choices explicit (prompt families, counterfactual protocols, metrics, and refusal handling) enabling reproducibility, comparability, and accountability. translated_title: 立场：生成模型中的公平性失败是一个评估问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16974v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管生成模型在过去十年取得了突破性进展，但对其缺乏公平性、加剧社会不平等和伤害边缘群体的担忧，仍未得到充分解决且难以采取行动。本立场论文认为，生成模型中的公平性失败虽然由多种因素驱动，但归根结底源于一个评估问题：公平性发现很少在论文之间具有可比性，或对部署决策具有可操作性。本文诊断了当前实践中反复出现的经验和概念性失败模式，并推动从临时性偏见检查转向标准化、生成模型专属的评估。我们提出“公平性卡片”作为最小化报告工具，使评估选择明确化（提示族、反事实协议、指标和拒绝处理），从而实现可复现性、可比性和问责性。我们以额外建议作为结论。
tldr: 本文提出生成模型公平性失败的核心是评估问题，并引入“公平性卡片”作为标准化报告工具，以提升公平性评估的可复现性、可比性和问责性。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that fairness failures in generative models stem from an evaluation problem and proposes Fairness Cards as a standardized reporting tool to enhance reproducibility, comparability, and accountability in fairness assessment.
